title: Conveyor Will Not Start
work_order: Operator reports that the conveyor will not start when the start button is pressed.

actions.inspect: The start button is not physically damaged.
actions.test: The start button sends a signal when pressed.
The motor does not receive power when start is pressed.

actions.inspect: The fuse looks dark through the glass.
actions.test: The fuse is open and has no continuity.

success_message: Correct. The control fuse is blown, preventing the motor control circuit from powering the conveyor.
failure_message: Incorrect. Review the evidence and try again.
